fromsoftware-dsr-product.name: FromSoftware Dark Souls Remastered product page
allowed_use: official product/platform identity
first-party release context
not_allowed_for: save offsets or parser mappings
copied gameplay tables or walkthrough prose
fromsoftware-dsr-product.risk: Official product pages are not a complete mechanics reference; recheck regional availability and page currentness.

bandai-dsr-product.name: Bandai Namco Dark Souls Remastered product page
allowed_use: official product and edition context
published platform or feature statements
not_allowed_for: canonical item/stat data
save offsets, event flags, or achievement ownership
copied page prose
bandai-dsr-product.risk: Marketing/product page; use only for claims it actually publishes and check regional redirects.

steam-dsr-store.name: Steam Dark Souls Remastered store listing
allowed_use: PC edition identity and published system/platform information
store-listed feature or release context
not_allowed_for: gameplay formulas or exact locations
save format or mod compatibility guarantees
steam-dsr-store.risk: Store metadata can change and is not a mechanics authority; check the listing date/context.

local-ds1-kernel.name: Bundled DSR deterministic kernel
allowed_use: stable mechanics exposed by ds1_core.py
spoiler gates, source-cache policy, and guide-search interface
deterministic command behavior
not_allowed_for: user-facing route/location prose absent from a cited source
current mod/version claims
save-backed facts not returned by ds1_save.py
local-ds1-kernel.risk: The kernel is intentionally narrow; missing rows and unsupported categories must remain unknown.

local-ds1-catalog.name: Bundled DSR catalog resources
local-ds1-catalog.license: GPL-3.0-or-later skill resources; per-row provenance applies
allowed_use: known weapon/ring/goods/magic name lookup
deterministic AR and compare helpers for rows present
not_allowed_for: inventing missing weapon rows or AR
proving item ownership or acquisition location
bulk replacement with unlicensed datasets
local-ds1-catalog.risk: Thin catalog by design; unknown and ambiguous names must be reported as unknown.

darksouls-wikidot.name: Dark Souls Wikidot
darksouls-wikidot.license: Wiki license varies by page; verify before reuse
allowed_use: secondary mechanics cross-checks
live cited item, area, and route summaries after spoiler permission
not_allowed_for: DSR save offsets or parser truth
bulk page copying or unreviewed table imports
darksouls-wikidot.risk: Community pages can be incomplete or spoiler-heavy; cite the specific page and corroborate contested facts.

fextralife-dsr.name: Fextralife Dark Souls wiki
fextralife-dsr.license: CC BY-NC-SA (site terms and page scope apply)
allowed_use: live cited route, location, NPC, boss, item, and farming prose
secondary mechanics cross-checks
not_allowed_for: canonical save/event data
bulk copied wiki prose or tables
unqualified current mod claims
fextralife-dsr.risk: Spoiler-heavy and sometimes inconsistent; summarize and cite, do not embed.

pcgamingwiki-dsr.name: PCGamingWiki Dark Souls Remastered
allowed_use: live cited PC settings, fixes, and compatibility context
current troubleshooting leads
not_allowed_for: gameplay/stat formulas
save offsets or achievement state
guaranteed compatibility or online safety
pcgamingwiki-dsr.risk: Version, executable, OS, and mod-loader differences matter; verify current pages before claiming support.

soulsplanner-dsr.name: SoulsPlanner Dark Souls calculator
allowed_use: manual AR/build sanity cross-checks
comparison of discrepancies with local deterministic output
not_allowed_for: copied formulas or datasets
canonical embedded catalog rows
save or progression claims
soulsplanner-dsr.risk: Reference-only unless licensing and version scope are established; do not present as proof.

speedrun-dsr.name: Speedrun.com Dark Souls Remastered resources
speedrun-dsr.license: Community site; license varies by resource
allowed_use: route and timing context when the user explicitly asks for speedrun guidance
community resource discovery
not_allowed_for: general-purpose safe route claims without spoiler permission
copied guide text or canonical gameplay data
save parser mappings
speedrun-dsr.risk: Speedrun routes intentionally skip content and may be version/category-specific; identify category and patch.

psnprofiles-dsr-guide.name: User-provided PSNProfiles Dark Souls Remastered platinum guide
psnprofiles-dsr-guide.license: User-provided PDF; redistribution rights not established
allowed_use: targeted local guide search through transformed chunks
short attributed summaries after spoiler permission
not_allowed_for: tracking or bundling the source PDF
raw PDF text or long quotations
save/parser truth or authoritative mechanics
bulk republishing or relicensing
psnprofiles-dsr-guide.risk: Spoiler-heavy and non-authoritative. The PDF is not tracked; only generated manifest/chunks are retained.

dsr-guide-corpus.name: Transformed DSR platinum-guide chunk corpus
dsr-guide-corpus.license: Derived local artifact; source redistribution rights not established
allowed_use: guide search/get lookup through the CLI
minimum necessary attributed summary
not_allowed_for: raw-text dumping
claiming parser or save authority
adding copied guide prose elsewhere in resources
dsr-guide-corpus.risk: Rows are transformed from a user-provided PDF and can contain future spoilers; preserve the corpus warning.

dsr-dadbod-transcripts.name: User-provided DSR Dadbod video transcripts
dsr-dadbod-transcripts.license: User-provided automatic-caption transcript source; rights unknown
allowed_use: narrow local transcript search/get through the transcript CLI
minimum necessary attributed summary after spoiler permission
not_allowed_for: bundling or redistributing the raw transcript JSON
raw transcript dumping or long quotations
mechanics, save, parser, or route truth
conflation with the PSNProfiles guide corpus or deterministic resources
dsr-dadbod-transcripts.risk: English en-orig automatic captions are spoiler-heavy, potentially inaccurate, and non-authoritative; preserve the warning and exact video provenance.

piroshkiv-dsr-save.name: Piroshkiv DSRSave
allowed_use: DSR PC container/slot integrity and AES/MD5 layout reference
name, stats, level, and class field offset cross-checks for read-only parsing
not_allowed_for: save mutation/editor workflows
unvalidated inventory, boss, bonfire, quest, or achievement offsets
DS3 layout reuse or online cheat guidance
piroshkiv-dsr-save.risk: Use only the source rows independently validated by ds1_save.py; repository coverage does not prove every category.

ds1-save-parser-contract.name: Validated local DSR read-only save parser contract
allowed_use: only fields explicitly supported by ds1_save.py
explicit unsupported results for unvalidated categories
not_allowed_for: DS3 save layout reuse
save mutation, repair, decryption, or re-encryption
inference from unknown IDs, absent offsets, or static checklists
ds1-save-parser-contract.risk: DSR save versions and layouts require defensible validation; unsupported means unknown, not false.

local-dsr-frame-extraction.name: Local DSR frame extraction scanner
local-dsr-frame-extraction.license: Local proprietary/user-only game installation data; redistribution rights not granted
allowed_use: read-only extraction from an explicitly supplied local DSR install
transient selected timing summaries through the frames CLI
not_allowed_for: bundling or retaining frame JSON, game assets, extracted names/parameter tables, raw payload bytes, or absolute install paths
writing the installation, caches, or output files
spell/equipment timing claims or resolved player-facing move labels
local-dsr-frame-extraction.risk: Proprietary local game data is version- and install-dependent; goods timing can be representative and weapon move labels remain unresolved.
